rules: Capture from a fresh install loaded with the fictional demo company only. Never capture from a real database.
Output folder: docs/images/. File names are stable; the README embeds them as docs/images/NN-name.png.
A user value 'terminal' means a terminal capture (PowerShell or Command Prompt window, the command and its output visible). Do not fake output.

Demo users (see docs/guide/demo-data in the README, section 13): admin = ADMIN role (Asha Menon, login admin); maker = Junior Accountant (Maya Rao); checker = Senior Accountant (Dev Iyer); approver = CFO (Priya Nair); viewer = Audit role (Sam Patel) with read-only permissions. Verify the viewer's permissions before capture.
Entries marked 'API-only' have no screen in this release: capture the terminal output of the command shown in the notes.
Entries whose screen does not exist or is not reachable are listed in docs/guide-open-issues.md; capture them only if the screen exists when you run this.
